gui_forms::Window.summary: Window is GUI.Forms' portable retained-root coordinator. It owns exact tree identity, update/layout/paint transactions, damage and presentation receipts, live layers, frame requests, UI-thread dispatch, resources, focus/validation/dialog keys, pointer/drag/deferred input, popups and accelerators, metrics, and semantic projection; native adapters reach it only through the host session and wake seams.
remarks: Provides resize and logical scale; nested update scopes, explicit layout, flush, paint, and per-plane damage; retained lookup by stable ID and recursive hit testing; focus, pointer capture, pressed state, and routed input dispatch.
Owns the retained accept/cancel targets and the exact retained `DialogResult`; dialog keys route to live targets only after the focused route declines them and never move focus.

A paint pass holds one exclusive UI-thread lease. `paint` returns an exact `PaintReceipt` only after complete backend replay; native hosts present only a valid receipt and then call `notify_presented`. Duplicate, backward, forged-future, and replaced-epoch receipts are rejected and counted.
Exposes frame scheduling, occlusion and wake deadlines, UI timer callbacks, validated PNG resource loading, renderer-free semantic snapshots, and structured metrics.
gui_forms::Window.ownership: Owns one retained root control tree and one UI thread. The application constructs the Window and keeps it alive for the lifetime of its tree; a native host adapter attaches to it. Window shutdown synchronously revokes timers, popups, paint leases, and pending dispatcher work.
gui_forms::Window.threading: The Window defines the UI thread. `check_access` reports whether the caller is on it and `verify_access` rejects any other caller; `begin_invoke`/`invoke` marshal work onto it. Only the dispatcher entry points may be called from other threads.
gui_forms::Window.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.

gui_forms::Window::Window|void (Control:.summary: Constructs one retained root on the creating UI thread, creates bounded dispatcher/frame lifetime state, attaches the tree, and seeds complete initial damage; copying is prohibited because identity and native attachment are singular.

gui_forms::Window::queue_live_surface_pr.summary: Registers or refreshes one attached control's durable producer surface without converting producer publication into retained repaint callbacks.

gui_forms::Window::take_live_surface_pre.summary: Samples registered live surfaces into immutable geometry/clip placements for native composition and retires dead registrations.
